info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Connelli Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Connelli Laptop Detail Management API enables businesses to add and manage detailed information about Connelli laptops. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive specifications, configurations, and unique features of the laptops. Typically utilized by product managers and e-commerce platforms, this API supports the seamless integration of catalog management into existing systems. Through this operational capability, companies can enhance their product offerings and ensure accurate representation in the marketplace.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit and create new details for a Connelli laptop. It processes the provided data and stores it for future reference.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details to create or update the Connelli laptop information. It should adhere to the specified schema to ensure proper processing and validation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, returning the requested laptop details.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person requesting the laptop.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the requested laptop.

tags.description: Array of tags associated with the request for the laptop.

items.description: A tag describing a characteristic or category of the laptop.

supplier.description: Details about the supplier providing the laptop.
